name: Nuno Forte + Blast + Rabbit
description: Nuno Forte, Blast, and Rabbit perform at Era uma vez no Porto on 27 November 2026.
longDescription:
Nuno Forte, Blast, and Rabbit will play a club night hosted at Era uma vez no Porto, located on Rua da Madeira. The lineup is presented under Nerve Attack.

The event takes place on 27 November 2026, running from 23:59 to 06:00. Admission is 6 euros and entry is restricted to ages 18 and over.
